## Taxonomy

**Category** (learning paradigm):
- [ ] Supervised — classification, regression, labeled data
- [ ] Unsupervised — clustering, dimensionality reduction, generative modeling
- [ ] Reinforcement — policy optimization, reward learning
- [ ] Self-Supervised — contrastive learning, masked prediction, pretext tasks
- [ ] Meta-Learning — few-shot, MAML, hyperparameter optimization, NAS
- [ ] Continual — catastrophic forgetting, incremental learning
- [ ] Transfer — domain adaptation, pretraining + finetuning, foundation models
- [ ] Multi-Agent — emergent communication, cooperative/competitive learning
- [ ] Active — query strategies, human-in-the-loop
- [ ] Online — streaming learning, bandits, non-stationary environments
- [ ] Federated — privacy-preserving distributed learning, differential privacy
- [ ] Curriculum — self-paced learning, hard example mining
- [ ] Neurosymbolic — logic + neural integration, differentiable reasoning
- [ ] Causal — causal inference, causal discovery, counterfactual learning

**Subcategory** (scope/approach):
- [ ] Theory — convergence, generalization bounds, information theory
- [ ] Algorithm — new algorithms, methods
- [ ] Architecture — transformers, CNNs, GNNs, attention mechanisms
- [ ] Optimization — optimizers, regularization, loss functions
- [ ] Scaling — scaling laws, compute-optimal training
- [ ] Efficient — compression, quantization, distillation, pruning
- [ ] Robust — adversarial, OOD, fairness, safety
- [ ] Application — NLP, CV, robotics, science, healthcare
